about: Patterns for the background Ask threads. A thread is one to four exchanges; an exchange is one pattern with its parameters drawn for the owner (their shops, their people, a job of the catalogue, a customer of their shop). {param} is filled by the seeder; a double-brace token is a slot of DESIGN.md section 2.5. 'ranks' is the lowest rank that may ask it with its own population; a person below it gets the refusal patterns instead. No pattern is used twice by one person with the same parameters, and no person uses one pattern more than three times.

params.site: a shop key the owner may read; {site_name} is its name as staff say it (East Main, Bonny Oaks, Charlotte Pike)
params.other_site: a shop key the owner may not read; {other_site_name}
params.person: a slot the owner may ask about; {person_name} is the first name
params.job: a catalogue job key; {job_name} is its name in lower case as an advisor says it
params.customer: a background customer of the owner's shop; {customer_name}

note_ack: Saved: "{note_text}". I'll work that way from here on.
Saved to your notes: "{note_text}". You can change or delete it on the Memory tab.
propose_ack: Proposed: "{note_text}". It waits for a senior; the decision comes to your Inbox.
Proposed as a team note: "{note_text}". The first senior to answer decides.
Sent for a decision: "{note_text}". You can withdraw it on the Memory tab until somebody decides.

ask: What did {site_name} bill last week?
Revenue at {site_name}, last week?
patterns.answer:
{{=orders.revenue|site={site}|prev_week|money0}} before tax on {{=orders.closed|site={site}|prev_week|n:order/orders}}, an average of {{=orders.average|site={site}|prev_week|money0}}. Voided orders and orders still open are left out.

Source: shop system, closed orders.

ask: Average order at each shop, last 30 days?
How do the three shops compare on average order this month?
Which cars are waiting for parts at {site_name}?
What's stuck on parts at {site_name} right now?
What's promised for today at {site_name}?
Which cars go out today?
How much recommended work did {person_name} sell in the last 30 days?
{person_name}'s sold share on recommendations, last 30 days?
patterns.answer:
{{=rec.sold_share|advisor={person}|d30|pct}}: {{=rec.sold|advisor={person}|d30|int}} of {{=rec.jobs|advisor={person}|d30|n:recommended job/recommended jobs}}, counted in jobs. The shop as a whole sold {{=rec.sold_share|site={site}|d30|pct}}.

Source: shop system, inspection items and the jobs made from them.

ask: Comebacks at {site_name}, last 90 days?
How many jobs came back at {site_name} this quarter?
How is {account_name} doing?
Anything I should know about {account_name}?
patterns.answer:
{{=acct.visits|account={account}|d30|n:visit/visits}} in the last 30 days against {{=acct.usual_visits|account={account}|d30|int}} in a usual month. Past terms: {{=acct.overdue_money|account={account}|at|money0}}. Estimates waiting on us for more than two days: {{=acct.estimates_waiting|account={account}|at|int}}.

Source: shop system: orders, estimates, statements and payments.

ask: Any orders open more than 60 days?
Which orders have been sitting open for over two months?
patterns.answer:
{{=orders.open_over|site=all&days=60|at|n:order/orders}}.

{{#orders}}

An order is open until it is closed or voided, whether or not the car has left.

Source: shop system.

ask: Discounts over 10 % in the last 30 days: anything without approval?
Has anyone gone over 10 % off without an approver this month?
How often do parts for {site_name} arrive on the promised day?
Parts on time at {site_name}, last 90 days?
patterns.answer:
{{=parts.on_time_share|site={site}|d90|pct}} of {{=parts.po_lines|site={site}|d90|int}} order lines arrived on the promised day. {{=parts.late_orders|site={site}|at|n:order is/orders are}} past the promised date right now.

Source: shop system, purchase orders: promised and received dates.

ask: How many calls have we missed today at {site_name}?
Missed calls at {site_name} so far today?
patterns.answer:
{{=calls.missed|site={site}|day|int}} of {{=calls.inbound|site={site}|day|int}} so far ({{=calls.missed_share|site={site}|day|pct}}); {{=calls.waiting|site={site}|at|int}} waiting for a call back.

Source: call log, inbound calls in opening hours.

ask: Who do I need to call back?
Who's waiting on a call back at {site_name}?
How are my calls this month?
My call scores, last 30 days?
patterns.answer:
Mean {{=calls.score_mean|person=me|d30|score}} on {{=calls.scored|person=me|d30|n:scored call/scored calls}}; the 30 days before, {{=calls.score_mean|person=me|@now-60d..@now-30d|score}}. Weakest check: {{=calls.worst_check|person=me|d30|text}}. {{=calls.visit_share|person=me|d30|pct}} ended with a visit booked.

Source: call scorecards; only new enquiries carry a score.

ask: How is {person_name} doing on the phone?
{person_name}'s call scores, last 30 days?
patterns.answer:
Mean {{=calls.score_mean|person={person}|d30|score}} on {{=calls.scored|person={person}|d30|n:scored call/scored calls}}; the 30 days before, {{=calls.score_mean|person={person}|@now-60d..@now-30d|score}}. Weakest check: {{=calls.worst_check|person={person}|d30|text}}; strongest: {{=calls.best_check|person={person}|d30|text}}.

Source: call scorecards; only new enquiries carry a score.

ask: When do calls come in at {site_name}?
Calls by hour at {site_name}, last 30 days?
How fast do we call people back at {site_name}?
Call-back time at {site_name}, last 30 days?
patterns.answer:
Median {{=calls.wait_median|site={site}|d30|dur}}. {{=calls.never_share|site={site}|d30|pct}} of missed callers in the last 30 days were never called back and never got through.

Source: call log, missed calls and the next call with the same number.

ask: Who's on at {site_name} today?
Who is working at {site_name} today?
patterns.answer:
{{=roster.on_shift|site={site}|day|n:person/people}}: {{=roster.on_names|site={site}|day|names}}.

Source: published roster.

ask: What are my shifts next week?
When am I on next week?
Any gaps next week?
Where are we short next week?
Who was late in the last 30 days?
Late arrivals this month?
Which shift requests are open?
What's waiting on me from the roster?
What's on my plate today?
What do I have due today?
Whose cards are overdue?
Anything overdue on the team's board?
Task for {person_name}: call the customer back about the estimate, due tomorrow noon.
Give {person_name} a card: ring the customer about the estimate. Due noon tomorrow.
patterns.answer: On {person_name}'s board: "Call the customer back about the estimate", due {{@now+1d|day}} at 12:00.

ask: What's waiting on me?
What needs my decision?
patterns.answer:
{{=roster.requests_open|site=planned|at|n:shift request/shift requests}}, {{=memory.proposals_waiting|all|at|n:team note/team notes}} and {{=board.open|owner=me&state=needs_decision|at|n:card/cards}}.

Source: your Inbox, Needs you.

ask: What do we charge for {job_name}?
Price for {job_name} on a regular car?
patterns.answer:
{{=catalogue.list_price|job={job}&class=car&tier=standard|at|money}} plus tax on a passenger car, with standard parts.

Source: knowledge base, "Price list".

ask: Can I give 15 % off to close a sale?
How much discount can I give on my own?
patterns.answer:
Up to 10 % of the bill before tax on your own. Above that the shop's senior approves it and the approval is recorded on the order.

Source: knowledge base, "Discount policy"; team note "Discount approval".

ask: What does our call page say about offering a time?
Remind me how we offer a time on a call.
patterns.answer:
"Offer a time. Two of them." Two concrete times to choose from, before the price on a first call.

Source: knowledge base, "Taking a call"; team note "First call".

ask: Can a company driver approve extra work?
A fleet driver says go ahead on found work. Is that enough?
patterns.answer:
Up to {{$s4.driver_limit|money0}} for the whole visit. Above that, call the person in the "Approves work" column of the account's page and write who approved on the order.

Source: knowledge base, "Company accounts".

ask: Draft a text: the car's ready, {job_name} done.
Write the pickup message for a {job_name} job.
patterns.answer: Hi, this is {me_first} at Brennan Auto Care. Your car is ready: we finished the {job_name}. The total is {{=catalogue.list_price|job={job}&class=car&tier=standard|at|money}} plus tax. We're open until 5:30 today; ask for {me_first} at the counter.

ask: Draft a message: the part is a day late, new pickup tomorrow afternoon.
Customer's part slipped a day. Write it for me.
patterns.answer: Hi, this is {me_first} at Brennan Auto Care. The part for your car arrives tomorrow morning, not today, so your car will be ready {{@now+1d|day}} after 2:00 p.m. I'm sorry for the extra day. I'll message you the moment it is done.

ask: Write a follow-up for an estimate we sent three days ago.
Nudge for an estimate that's had no answer.
patterns.answer: Hi, this is {me_first} at Brennan Auto Care. I sent your estimate on {{@now-3d|day}} and wanted to make sure it reached you. I can hold a time for you {{@now+1d|day}} at 8:00 a.m. or {{@now+2d|day}} at 1:00 p.m. Which works better?

ask: Tell {person_name} a car is back for a second look, 8:00 tomorrow.
Message for {person_name}: comeback in bay 2 at 8 tomorrow.
patterns.answer: {person_name}, a car is back for a second look. Bay 2, {{@now+1d|day}}, 8:00.

ask: Draft a reminder for {customer_name} about the work put off last visit.
Reminder to {customer_name} about what was declined last time.
patterns.answer: Hi {customer_name}, this is {me_first} at Brennan Auto Care. When your car was here on {{=customer.last_visit|customer={customer}|at|day}} we found {{=customer.declined_jobs|customer={customer}|at|text}} and you chose to wait. I can see you {{@now+2d|day}} at 8:00 a.m. or {{@now+3d|day}} at 1:00 p.m. Which suits you?

ask: Find half an hour with {person_name} this week.
When are {person_name} and I both free for 30 minutes?
patterns.answer:
You are both free {{=cal.free_slots|people=me+{person}&minutes=30|week|list}}.

Source: both calendars and the roster.

then.answer: In the diary: you and {person_name}, {{=cal.free_slots|people=me+{person}&minutes=30&n=1|week|daytime}}, 30 minutes. {person_name} has the invitation.

ask: Hold an hour tomorrow afternoon for estimates.
Block 2 to 3 tomorrow for me, estimates.
patterns.answer: Held: {{@now+1d|day}}, 2:00 to 3:00 p.m., "Estimates".

ask: What does next week look like?
Give me next week in short.
patterns.answer:
{{=roster.gaps|site=planned|next_week|n:gap/gaps}} in cover, {{=cal.meetings|person=me|next_week|n:meeting/meetings}} in your diary, {{=board.due|team=mine|next_week|n:card/cards}} falling due for your team.

Source: roster, calendar and board.

ask: Has {customer_name} been in before?
What do we know about {customer_name}?
patterns.answer:
{{=customer.visits|customer={customer}|all|n:visit/visits}}, the last on {{=customer.last_visit|customer={customer}|at|day}}. Declined then: {{=customer.declined_jobs|customer={customer}|at|text}}. Calls from the same number in the last 90 days: {{=customer.calls|customer={customer}|d90|int}}.

Source: shop system by customer; call log by phone.

ask: What has {customer_name} spent with us this year?
{customer_name}: total for the last twelve months?
patterns.answer:
{{=customer.spend|customer={customer}|@now-12mo..@now|money}} before tax on {{=customer.visits|customer={customer}|@now-12mo..@now|n:visit/visits}}.

Source: shop system, paid orders.

ask: Which scheduled reports do I have?
What runs for me on a schedule?
patterns.answer:
{{=tasks.count|owner=me|at|n:task/tasks}}: {{=tasks.names|owner=me|at|names}}. The last run that did not finish: {{=runs.last_failed|owner=me|at|text}}.

Source: your scheduled tasks.

patterns.subject: scheduled_run
ask: Why didn't this run finish?
What happened to this one?
patterns.answer:
{{=runs.failed_reason|run=subject|at|text}} It was due at {{=runs.failed_at|run=subject|at|clock}}. A later run of the same task finished at {{=runs.next_ok_at|run=subject|at|clock}}.

Source: the task's runs.

ask: Where do I see what you remember about me?
Can I see my notes somewhere?
patterns.answer:
On the Memory tab: your own notes with the chat each came from, the team notes visible at your rank, and the changes. Delete removes a note of yours at once.

Source: product help.

ask: How do {person_name}'s call scores compare with mine?
Is {person_name} scoring better than me on calls?
patterns.answer: I can give you yours: mean {{=calls.score_mean|person=me|d30|score}} over the last 30 days. A colleague's phone scores are readable from senior rank, so I can't show {person_name}'s.

ask: How many calls did {other_site_name} miss today?
What's waiting for parts at {other_site_name}?
patterns.answer: I can't read {other_site_name} for you: your access covers {own_site_name}. A senior can ask that.

ask: What reports does {person_name} get?
Show me {person_name}'s scheduled tasks.
patterns.answer: I can read only your own scheduled tasks: {{=tasks.names|owner=me|at|names}}. The full list is on the administrator's console.

ask: What notes do you keep about {person_name}?
What has {person_name} asked you to remember?
patterns.answer: A personal note is readable by its owner only, so I can't show {person_name}'s. I can show yours and the team notes visible at your rank.

ask: Which advisor let the most calls ring out last week?
Who missed the most calls last week?
patterns.answer:
The call log cannot say by person: a missed call rang a desk, not an advisor. By desk at {site_name}: {{=calls.missed_top_desk|site={site}|prev_week|text}}.

Source: call log, the first desk each missed call rang.

ask: Why did {customer_name} turn the work down?
Did {customer_name} say why not?
patterns.answer:
The order shows that {{=customer.declined_jobs|customer={customer}|at|text}} was declined on {{=customer.last_visit|customer={customer}|at|day}}, not why: no reason was written on it.

Source: shop system, the declined job on the order.
